name: Zeetoo-Zeetoo
description: Zeetoo-Zeetoo, nicknamed "Zeet," was an astromech droid belonging to Shepherd Squadron pilot Bak Rychuk. The droid was destroyed after a brief encounter with a scavenger named Rey on the Imperial Interdictor Spectral.

data.name: Zeetoo-Zeetoo
data.death: Sometime before the attack on Tuanul, Jakku
